decisive_items: Mycological culture yielded growth of Trichophyton mentagrophytes
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by a definitive mycological culture identifying Trichophyton mentagrophytes in a patient with compatible erythematous, infiltrating, well-demarcated skin lesions. R2 relies only on nonspecific eosinophilia and elevated IgE, which can accompany fungal infection and do not establish eosinophilic dermatitis as the diagnosis.

rejected.why: Raw support is limited to elevated eosinophils and IgE, which are nonspecific and can be secondary to dermatophytosis; there is no raw evidence of eosinophilic dermatitis as a distinct entity.
